name: AIRF Advanced Intelligent Restock Forecast
author: Thinlayerlabs

sections.description:
This plugin sends anonymized and aggregated sales data (product SKUs, monthly sales quantities, stock, and supplier lead days) to your API for forecasting analysis.
Forecast computation, plan/quota enforcement, and analysis history are provided by the AIRF external service, while this plugin handles WooCommerce integration and admin UI.

External services used:
1. AIRF forecasting API at https://api-airf.thinlayerlabs.com
– Purpose: site registration, plan/quota status, analysis, cached analysis, analysis history, and customer-country settings.
– Data sent: store domain, WordPress/WooCommerce/plugin version metadata, recovery email for registration, and anonymized/aggregated inventory and sales signals (SKU, product name, stock, price, monthly sales totals, lead days).
– Data not sent: customer names, customer email addresses, customer phone numbers, customer addresses, payment details.
– Trigger: after an admin explicitly consents in the setup screen, requests verification code, and verifies the site; then during analysis/status sync and scheduled analysis tasks.
– Config: override API endpoint with AIRF_API_BASE_URL and legal links with AIRF_SITE_BASE_URL, AIRF_TERMS_URL, or AIRF_PRIVACY_URL.
– Service terms: https://thinlayerlabs.com/terms
– Service privacy policy: https://thinlayerlabs.com/privacy
2. OpenAI and Supabase are used only by the AIRF API backend (not called directly by this plugin)

Store owners do not need to create an external account to view forecast status in WordPress admin.

Features in this version:
1. Site registration and plan/quota status in WooCommerce admin
2. Manual “Run analysis now” trigger and nightly scheduled analysis
3. Supplier lead-time field on WooCommerce product inventory tab
4. Weekly digest toggle that emails recommendations to admin email
5. Service plan links for Starter and Growth plans (uses Polar checkout and customer portal URLs)
6. Cached recommendation table in admin sorted by urgency
7. Outcome notices for quota exceeded, low confidence, stale cache fallback, and success states

Billing toggle notes:
1. Store owners do not need to configure billing URLs manually. Service plan links are preconfigured in the plugin.
2. You can disable billing UI with AIRF_BILLING_ENABLED=false if you want a free-only setup.
3. Advanced deployments can override checkout/portal URLs via constants or environment variables (AIRF_POLAR_CHECKOUT_URL, AIRF_POLAR_STARTER_CHECKOUT_URL, AIRF_POLAR_GROWTH_CHECKOUT_URL, AIRF_POLAR_PORTAL_URL).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/airf-restock-forecast
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress
  3. Open WooCommerce > AIRF Restock Forecast
sections.faq:
Does this plugin send data to an external service?

Yes. Anonymized and aggregated sales data is sent to the AIRF forecasting API for analysis. No customer personal data is transmitted.

Do I need an external account?

No external account is required. An admin starts registration from within WordPress by entering a recovery email, consenting to Terms/Privacy, and completing email verification.

Do I need to edit wp-config.php to use Starter or Growth plans?

No. The plugin already includes service plan and billing portal links for normal store use. Constants and environment variables are optional overrides for custom deployments.

What WooCommerce data is used?

Product SKUs, monthly sales quantities, current stock levels, prices, and supplier lead days that you enter on each product.

Can I use the plugin on the Free plan?

Yes. The Free plan includes limited monthly analysis credits. Starter and Growth plans provide higher quotas and expanded service outputs.
sections.changelog:
0.4.2

  • Updated plugin metadata and product page link for review resubmission.
  • Reworked POST array sanitization to satisfy Plugin Check 1.9.0.

0.4.1

  • Updated bundled Chart.js to 4.5.1.
  • Moved verification screen JavaScript to the admin enqueue flow.
  • Replaced flagged input reads with explicit sanitization.
  • Removed the hardcoded cron URL trigger.

0.4.0

  • Email-verified domain registration and account recovery.
  • Auto-analysis scheduling with day/time picker.
  • Customer base country picker with market event insights.
  • Demand forecast charts with zoom and pan.
  • Revenue impact analysis and reorder calendar.
  • Seasonal pattern detection and demand anomaly alerts.
  • Supplier order report generation.
  • CSV export and print report.
  • Polar billing integration for Starter and Growth plans.
  • Local bundled chart libraries for admin visualizations.

0.1.0

  • Initial implementation scaffold.
  • Added supplier lead-time product field.
  • Added weekly digest schedule and email sender.
  • Added service plan links in admin page.
